semiconductor_relevance: High — Letry provides advanced process technology solutions and equipment specifically for high-end semiconductor applications.
summary: Letry (Shanghai) Clean Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in delivering comprehensive solutions for the semiconductor industry, including high-purity materials and wet process equipment. Their offerings support various applications such as integrated circuits and LED lighting, catering to leading semiconductor and photovoltaic companies.

regional_presence.China: Letry has a significant operational footprint in China, serving major semiconductor enterprises.
regional_presence.Europe: The company extends its business operations into Europe, targeting high-end industry customers.
regional_presence.Southeast Asia: Letry also has a presence in Southeast Asia, supporting regional semiconductor and photovoltaic markets.
